title: Continuity 10x10
texts: Very easy climbing - 10 mins on, 10 mins rest.

The aim of this workout is to maintain an increased level of blood flow to the forearms without creating a high level of muscle pump.  Find an easy route, circuit or section wall where you can climb for 10 minutes without stopping.  You should not feel pumped during this session as the intensity should remain very low.  

Complete this 10 minute rep 3 times in total and rest for 10 minutes between each set. This is a great session to complete on routes with a climbing partner.
